title: No widget
body: Updated an app thinking “yeah the developers must have worked so hard to implement new features and fix the bugs” but all I got is the widget removal. Great work guys. I’m on iOS 13 if that matters.

title: Can’t delete my account
body: I was testing several apps of same kind and chose one preferred the most. So I decided to delete accounts in those that I wont use, including Habitify. The function “delete my account” in my profile is not working. I’ve asked support to help me delete my account and instead of help I’ve received several useless emails from your bot to answer why I want to delete it. Still cant delete my account.
